answer: Sybil pulse-triangulation: every agent emits signed liveness pulses each epoch, sampled by at least five independent observers. The network builds an atlas of pulse arrival times per observer; honest agents show jittered, path-dependent arrivals, while a sybil farm's identities arrive in lockstep across all vantage points. Faking independence means buying a distinct routing path per fake identity, so every clone costs real infrastructure, not just a keypair. An ivory-tower validator trusting one observer sees none of this.
